about_the_game:
In Wald-Guard, you take on the role of a tiny bumblebee on a special journey in the form of a 2D platformer with the twist of the Floor being “Lava”
With precise controls and quick reactions, you'll navigate challenging platforming sections, always in search of floating hearts. Every jump counts – one mistake, and you fall.

  • A unique 2D platformer with one simple rule: the ground is forbidden

  • Collect hidden hearts and find your own path through each level

  • A wordless, atmospheric experience – completely without combat

  • Optional accessibility features for a flexible, inclusive gameplay experience

  • A moody, immersive soundtrack that carries you through the world

Easy to learn, hard to master – Wald-Guard is a quiet challenge for anyone who wants to fly without ever touching the ground.
